title: logs consolidated into python/logs/
author: Claude-JG
description: The four log directories python/TestSuiteLogs/; python/TestExamplesLogs/; python/PerformanceLogs/ and python/logsTmp/ are consolidated into python/logs/ with one subdirectory per kind (testmodels; examples; performance) and a shared tmp/. revision2026 step R3.8.
releaseNotes: The four log directories became python/logs/{testmodels; examples; performance; tmp}. 62 tracked logs moved with git mv so history follows them; decision D7 unchanged - they stay tracked. Four logFileName expressions and testRunnerTools.tmpLogDir updated. The -local CI copy still goes to the working directory python/TestModels/; so both artifact globs stayed correct and no workflow file was touched. Verified: ResolveLogFile found the existing performance log under ../logs/performance/ and diverted to ../logs/tmp/.
